da-non-sequitur.evidence: (S↔P column of prop:categorical-mass-markov row) Ref `qou:QOU.CategoricalMassMarkov` resolves to the library structure in lean/QOU/CategoricalMassMarkov.lean, which belongs to a different block (`…-trace-endomorphism-intro`). It is an additive map plus a sequence and asserts nothing about mass = | ∫_A ρ(β) | . The sibling's `term_one` is a `def`. The real formalisation the proof cites does exist (`frobeniusForm_massIntegrand_of_frobeniusForm_eq_counit`, `braidTrace_wordBraid`, `massClass_wordBraid` in lean/QOU/Torsion/MassTrace*.lean, all present), and those three library files are under open PR #7990, but the ref does not point there. Proof: the algebra checks. Jimbo Ř with K = diag(1,q²) gives tr σ = z, tr σ₁σ₂ = z², tr σ₁σ₂σ₁ = hz²+z, 4₁ = (q⁸−q⁶+q⁴−q²+1)/(q²(q²+1)²), negative Markov scalar q⁻¹/(q²+1). The n = 2 check q³+q⁵ and the regular-trace values h/2, h²/6 also hold (all sympy, exact). The statement claims more than is proved. Step 1 needs ∫_A = ε, which is not in the statement, and the proof admits it is unverified. The proof's own point 1 shows (H_n, ∫_A) is not Frobenius for n ≥ 3, against the statement's premise. | · | on a generic commutative R is undefined. The block asserts "Im 𝔙 equals the β-decay Q-value", which the proof never touches. The proof's Explicit-values section calibrates E₀ "by anchoring to one experimental value"
